title.narrative: Enhance capacity of stakeholders on freedom & safety of scientists

description.narrative: This workplan outlines UNESCO’s strategic and operational approach to advancing scientific freedom and the protection of scientific researchers as integral components of the right to science. Normatively it is based on the 2017 Recommendation on Science and Scientific Researchers (RS|SR). It combines programme implementation with normative follow-up and evidence-based policymaking, structured around two complementary components: (1) operationalization of the Programme on the Freedom and Safety of Scientists and the associated Call to Action with particular attention to women scientists and emergencies, and (2) implementation and monitoring of the RS|SR and advancement of the right to science.
